_doc: Demo-book fixtures for headless scenes, parity scenes and scripts: the one file to change when the demo book is replaced.
Rust reads it at build time (src/fixtures.rs: fixtures::id("name"), fixtures::field, fixtures::now, fixtures::use_book).
parity/capture-rune.sh and parity/capture-tauri.mjs expand `{fx:name}` (the id) and `{fx:name.field}` in scene args and paths.
Each fixture's `select` re-resolves it on a new book from stable properties (wallet label, direction, exact amount):
python3 -I tools/demo-fixtures.py check <kassiber.sqlite3>     verify every id and field
python3 -I tools/demo-fixtures.py resolve <kassiber.sqlite3>   rewrite ids and fields from the selects
`books` are named variants of the demo book a scene needs (pending link reviews, a seeded source-of-funds case):
the scene copies the current book to a temporary root, runs these local CLI steps there and switches the daemon to it.
Steps run with --data-root <copy> --machine; `save` keeps data.id of the reply for later `{fx:saved.<name>}`.

partial.about: Latest Spending Wallet deposit: a partial graph whose spent input amount is missing (a lookup could add it); first row of Recent Transactions
partial.select: SELECT t.id FROM transactions t JOIN wallets w ON w.id = t.wallet_id WHERE w.label = 'Regtest Spending Wallet' AND t.direction = 'inbound' AND t.amount = 534123000
